cap declaration with associated type is valid
cap Iterator {
  type Item
  fn next(self: Iterator): Option[Item]
}
fn use_it(it: Iterator): Option[Item] = it.next(it)
---
use_it : (Iterator) -> Option[Item]

==========
next() return type resolved at concrete call site
data Option[A] { .some(A), .none }
data List[A] { .nil, .cons(A, List[A]) }
cap Iterator {
  type Item
  fn next(self: Iterator): Option[Item]
}
impl[T] List[T]: Iterator {
  type Item = T
  fn next(self: List[T]): Option[T] = Option.none
}
fn use_next(xs: List[Number]): Option[Number] = xs.next()
---
use_next : (List[Number]) -> Option[Number]
